title: Agrippa Syluius
summary: Raleigh names Agrippa Syluius in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Agrippa Syluius, and after him Syluius Alladius, were Kings of the Albans in Italie. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.

free_source_links.locator: Book II, Part I, Chapter XXII, §. VI, sig. 328a
